name: zpk_empty_zeros
comment: Sig: zpk -> tf via zp2tf. Regression for bugs/control/zpk-empty-zeros: zpk([],poles,k) (no finite zeros) must keep the gain k. zpk([],[-1 -2],2)=2/((s+1)(s+2)) -> num last coeff a=2 (was 0 before the fix — math::poly([]) returned empty, collapsing num and dropping k), numel(num)=3. Non-empty-zero case unaffected: zpk(-5,[-1 -2 -3],1)=(s+5)/(...) -> num=[0 0 1 5], n2(end)=5, n2(end-1)=1. Verified vs MATLAB R2025b. Fixes bugs/control/zpk-empty-zeros.
